title: Haaye Zehra Yateem hogayi
body:
haaye zehra sa. yateem hogayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
uth gaya baap ka sar se saaya.
<<MINI>>
haaye zehra yateem hogayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
ahlebait e muhammed asws. hai girya.
haaye…….
1. ro rahe hai ali asws. aur hassnain asws.
peet ke sar yeh karte hai sab bain.
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt kaisa yeh humpar hai aaya.
2. haaye baba ke naale hai lab par.
chal base mustafa saww. rabbe dawar.
ab masayeb sahegi yeh dukhiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. aapke baad yeh zulm hoga.
lakdiya leke aayenge aada.
haaye jal jaayega ghar hamara.
4. zeher dekar payambar saww. ko maara.
<<DIVIDER>>
shafi e roze mehshar ko maara.
dil pakadke tadapte hai moula.
5. syedul ambiya ausiya ka.
haaye haaye habeeb e quda ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
chand logo ne laasha uthaya.
6. seenazan hai yeh asghar asws. ke naukar.
haaye maare gaye hai payambar saww.
hai sabhi ke labo’n par yeh nauha.
<<MINI>>
haaye zehra sa. yateem hogayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
az: meer kumail ali(anjuman e asghari
